citations.quote:
[name="诗怀雅"]几支队伍都准备好了，九现在不在，你是主导者，所有人都在等你。
[dialog]
[character]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]	
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[Subtitle(text="所有人都在等我。", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[Subtitle(text="可如果我错了呢？", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
[subtitle]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[delay(time=1)]
[character(name="char_010_chen_1#4",fadetime=0.5)]
[name="陈"]我还不用你来教我做事。
[dialog]
[playsound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[character(fadetime=1.5)]
[delay(time=2)]
[Character(name="char_308_swire_1#5")]
[name="诗怀雅"]你最好不用。
[dialog]
[character]
[playsound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[character(name="char_136_hsguma_ns_1#1",fadetime=1.5)]
[delay(time=2)]
[name="星熊"]Missy，为什么你不把你当时走上去把手里的酒浇在那两个人头上的事也一起说了？
[Character(name="char_308_swire_1#3",name2="char_136_hsguma_ns_1#1",focus=1)]
[name="诗怀雅"]我又不是来安慰她，或者和她同仇敌忾的，我是来嘲笑她的。
